patterns.note: Full-screen, scroll-driven narrative sections that transform content rather than simply revealing new blocks.
Massive, semi-transparent display typography is used as a primary visual element and transitions between sections.
A muted, almost monochromatic base palette is accented by a diverse range of subtle, earthy, and sometimes vibrant colors for interactive elements and the brand logo.

The main title 'Earth, Recorded' scales down and repositions from a large, central element to a small header as the user scrolls, eventually disappearing. A 3D globe and country representations (from a list to a circular arrangement) also animate and transition between scroll depths.
Each scroll depth presents a distinct, full-screen visual state, creating a sequential, interactive story rather than a traditional stacked layout.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated scroll-triggered animation system, likely using canvas and CSS keyframes, to create a continuous, transforming experience. Elements like the main title dynamically scale, reposition, and fade based on scroll depth. Complex 3D elements, such as the globe and country representations, appear and animate in response to scroll events, creating a fluid transition between narrative states. A player UI also appears and disappears with specific scroll positions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, semi-transparent display headings (~5x body) with a clean sans-serif, complemented by a clear hierarchy of smaller body text and tiny monospace labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements and cards, maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous negative space defining distinct full-screen sections and emphasizing key visual elements.

standout: The site's standout feature is its highly interactive, scroll-driven narrative that uses large, transforming typography and a dynamic 3D globe to tell a story. It creates a unique sense of discovery and engagement by making the act of scrolling a core part of the content experience, rather than just navigation.
